connectors.name: github
connectors.title: GitHub
connectors.description: Repositories, issues, discussions, comments, pull requests, notifications and Markdown files from chosen repository paths, with relations and checks. A personal token reads only; a GitHub App can carry issue, discussion and comment edits back.

connectors.name: google-calendar
connectors.title: Google Calendar
connectors.description: Calendars and events of a Google account, read through the Calendar API, with changes to events made in Marfa carried back.

connectors.name: readwise
connectors.title: Readwise
connectors.description: Sources and complete highlights from one Readwise account, and, when turned on, Reader documents with supported two-way edits.

connectors.name: rss
connectors.title: RSS
connectors.description: Entries from Atom, RSS and JSON feeds.

connectors.name: todoist
connectors.title: Todoist
connectors.description: Tasks from a Todoist account, read through the Sync API, and every todoist.task in Marfa carried back to it.
